target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, virtio-ramfb, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-exact-current-f17.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps --probe-keepaway-full-game
checks: 3D mesh/interpolation, service and height-format fixtures passed; all three named 3D app entrypoints compiled.

KeepAway gameplay input and HUD refresh passed; scanout continued changing throughout a 184-second observation, Escape returned to a working terminal, zstatus reported failed=0, and no Animate child task remained.

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-interactive-exact-current-f17.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps
checks: GrModels Man generated a 112-vertex, 168-triangle mesh and completed terminal recovery; raster diagnostic observed 4,182 pixel writes.
GrModels Ball generated a 58-vertex, 128-triangle mesh, rendered its inline sprite, and completed terminal recovery.
KeepAway rendered gameplay, accepted Space/mouse input, refreshed its HUD, and returned via Escape to a working terminal.
Titanium rendered gameplay, accepted input, exited with Escape, and returned to a working terminal.

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-titanium-arrows-exact-current-f17.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-titanium-only
checks: Titanium key-start prompt advanced into gameplay; the exact current image accepted ordinary Left and Right keys and moved the player in the corresponding directions.
Escape returned to the graphical terminal, 40+2 returned 42, and zstatus reported failed=0.

scope_note: These checks use UTM's bundled QEMU framework with emulated devices, not the visible UTM app window. They validate the exact current ISO in this profile. The previously reported visible-window KeepAway freeze and physical Pi behavior remain separate acceptance items; audio was not exercised.
